summary: Master customs compliance and cross-border transport management with practical tools, duty control, and audit-ready workflows. Enroll with TrainingCred.
lede: Customs compliance combines tariff classification, shipment valuation and transport-document checks to support accurate declarations and coordinated freight movement. For customs, logistics and freight operations professionals, the course builds practical skills in reviewing origin evidence, reconciling declaration documents, calculating duty outcomes and managing clearance risks and transport exceptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle customs documentation, cross-border freight movement, and trade compliance decisions in day-to-day operations.
audience: Supply chain planners affected by customs holds
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, basic spreadsheet capability, and familiarity with import or export documents. A calculator, sample shipment records, or anonymized customs files will help you complete the worked exercises more effectively. The course does not require programming or specialized software installation.
